name: Path of the Storm Herald
description: A barbarian who channels the fury of a chosen environment — desert, sea, or tundra — into a raging elemental aura.
note: The 6th- and 14th-level features_by_level entries list all 3 environment variants of Storm Soul/Raging Storm — a real character only ever has the ONE matching their Storm Aura environment (chosen once at 3rd level, fixed thereafter), not all three. LevelUpTool-side resolution should filter to the character's chosen environment.
